tls_insecure.description: Skip TLS certificate verification (XCP-ng ships a self-signed certificate)

sr_uuid.description: SR to create restored VDIs on; defaults to the pool's default SR

name_suffix.description: Appended to the restored VM's name-label

keep_mac.description: Give the restored VIFs their original MAC addresses (disaster recovery). Leave false when the original VM still runs on the same network

keep_tags.description: Give the restored VM the original's tags (disaster recovery). Leave false when the original still exists, or tag-based backups will also select the copy

keep_secureboot_update.description: Let the target pool replace the restored VM's Secure Boot keys at next boot when it marks old (2011) certificates for update. Off by default: the update changes what the guest measures, so a key sealed to its vTPM (BitLocker) may stop unsealing
